data.headline: Dynamic and Highly Energetic Procurement Digital Transformation Servant and Leader
data.about:
Global procurement leader with extensive experience delivering $5M–$10M+ annual savings, embedding procurement into enterprise strategy, and building high-performance sourcing functions across technology, SaaS, manufacturing, and R&D environments. Expert in AI-ready procurement processes, supply chain resilience, ESG integration, and digital transformation. Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, optimize supplier performance, and navigate volatility through agile, data-driven decision-making. 

CORE COMPETENCIES

•	IT & SaaS Procurement Strategy
•	AI-Enabled Sourcing & Spend Analytics
•	Enterprise Contract Negotiation
•	Supplier Risk Governance & Resilience
•	ESG & Supplier Diversity Programs
•	RFP/RFQ Development & Execution
•	Procure-to-Pay (P2P) & Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) Automation
•	Stakeholder Engagement & Strategic Influence
•	Global Supplier Relationship Management
•	Corporate Business Travel and Expense Management

experiences.title: Senior Manager, Global Corporate (Indirect) Procurement (IT/Technology, Indirect/MRO, Contracts)
experiences.subtitle: Lytx, Inc. . Full-time
experiences.caption: Sep 2022 - Aug 2025 · 2 yrs 11 mos

description.text:
As Lytx's first Corporate Procurement Professional and Leader:

•	Delivered $5M+ in IT/Technology cost savings in FY2023 by renegotiating SaaS/Tech contracts (AWS, New Relic, NetSuite, Workday, Snowflake, Workboard).
•	Designed and implemented AI-ready procurement workflows, enabling predictive analytics and risk scoring through centralized data structures.
•	Built and executed a supplier risk governance framework, increasing visibility into performance and compliance, supporting ISO 27001 certification readiness and SOC2 requirements.
•	Led digital procurement transformation—automated workflows, centralized spend visibility, and integrated Finance, Legal, IT, Security into strategic sourcing decisions.
•	Developed centralized HW/SW asset database, accelerating AWS Cloud migration and cutting data center decommissioning by 2–3 months.

As Seismic's first Procurement Professional and Leader:

•	Realized $5M annual SaaS savings within 6 months through strategic renegotiations (Salesforce, Gainsight, Microsoft/Azure, Google/GCP, AWS, Adobe, ServiceNow).
•	Built procurement & contracts management functions from the ground up, implementing Coupa (P2P) and IronClad (CLM) to automate source-to-pay and contract lifecycles.
•	Established formal RFP processes across multiple departments, improving supplier competition and compliance.
•	Launched Supplier Diversity and DEI Program in collaboration with VP of Diversity & Inclusion.
•	Standardized IT hardware, executing RFPs that onboarded Lenovo, Apple, and Dell partnerships.

experiences.title: Senior Manager, Procurement (Technical/IT Sourcing, MRO, Contracts)

description.text:
•	Partnered with CIO to execute 5-Year IT Transformation Plan, standardizing hardware (Dell, Apple, Microsoft) and optimizing SaaS sourcing under NIH/Federal guidelines.

experiences.title: Manager, Global IT Procurement -- Business Operations, Cloud Services Division

description.text:
As Gaikai's first Procurement Professional and Leader:

•	Created global IT sourcing strategy, leveraging multi-region discount structures to drive savings and supply chain resilience.

experiences.title: Department Head: Procurement Manager, North America (Manufacturing Operations & Solar Farm Projects)
experiences.subtitle: Soitec Solar Industries, LLC . undefined
experiences.caption: Jan 2012 - Jun 2013 · 1 yr 5 mos

description.text:
As Soitec Solar's first U.S. Procurement Leader:

•	Executed domestic and global sourcing activities for industrial and electro-mechanical components to support US and EMEA manufacturing and power plant installation projects. 
•	Identified, selected and implemented direct, indirect and MRO suppliers while sustaining ISO requirements and environmental stewardship responsibilities.
•	Performed RFQ/RFP activities to provide analytics to accomplish lowest total cost of ownership; analyzed, negotiated and awarded supply and service agreements to meet BOM cost targets and budgets.
•	Served as liaison to source IT hardware, software and service, partnered with suppliers such as Dell, IBM, Oracle and TW Telecom for network implementation and Disaster Recovery measures.  
•	Led business development and roadmap discussions with internal and external partners and suppliers.
•	Directed procurement projects and administered division Travel Program; controlled activities to sustain lean manufacturing and maximize production output and profitability.
•	Sourced, qualified and implemented strategic aluminum extrusion and glass partners, harmonizing global plant pricing.
•	Co-selected, implemented and deployed compressed gases suppliers, securing long-term supply and achieving 25% annual savings.
•	Established multiple MRO suppliers, providing over $200K in cost avoidance for a state-of-the-art CPV solar module manufacturing facility.

•	Co-managed procurement processes for a multi-million dollar chemistry reagent manufacturing facility, oversaw all sourcing activities for materials, equipment, and services to meet budgets.  
•	Directed commodity management activities, facilitated refinement of material specifications, scope of work and supply chain strategies to execute RFQ processes leveraging both domestic and global spend volume.  
•	Utilized Kaizen analysis to achieve lowest total cost while maximizing quality, price, delivery and service.
•	Executed RFQs to yield over $1.6M annual savings for biologicals, chemicals, printing and packaging.
•	Renegotiated OEM supplier contracts to achieve over $800K annual savings. 
•	Achieved $200K DPO cash flow improvement by negotiating favorable Payment Terms with suppliers.
•	Created and led PFEP / Kanban team, transitioning more than 70% of materials into the “Supermarket”.  
•	Modernized spend database providing an improved understanding of the $88MM annual site expenditure portfolio for direct spend.

experiences.title: Department Head: Corporate Procurement Manager (AMPAC, Australia, New Zealand)
experiences.subtitle: Carl Zeiss Vision . undefined
experiences.caption: Jan 2009 - Sep 2010 · 1 yr 8 mos

description.text:
•	Directed efforts to consolidate and control procurement activities throughout North America, identified cost savings opportunities, managed RFQ/Bidding processes, and optimized IT spend by negotiating and partnering with key suppliers such as SAP, IBM, HP, Lenovo, AT&T and CDW. 
•	Administered Corporate Business Travel Program, designed and implemented new Travel Policy while serving as a key advisor to the Corporate Purchasing and T&E Card Programs.  
•	Led team responsible for the development of improved procurement, travel and facilities policies.
•	Negotiated and implemented Pricing Agreements with suppliers, earning an annual savings of $1.5MM.
•	Selected and deployed new Corporate Travel Agency and Policy, capturing $250K annual savings while providing enhanced travel booking tools and services. 
•	Developed and implemented spend database, providing visibility and improved understanding of $300MM in expenditures.

•	Managed and directed purchasing functions including product/service sourcing, vendor selection, price and contract terms negotiation and purchase order completion.  
•	Led on-site Vendor Managed Inventory programs, continuously negotiating unit/bulk pricing as consumption adjusted over time. 
•	Successfully negotiated capital equipment expenditures with a savings of 40%.
•	Consolidated supplier base, redistributing purchase volume to yield 20% reduction in weekly expenditures for consumables.
•	Renegotiated BIOCOM membership, providing over $50K in annual consumable expense savings.

•	Established bandwidth and rack usage expenditure analysis that achieving over $1MM annual savings with AT&T and Equinix.
•	Mediated network hardware and software license agreements that resulted in 40% and 25% savings respectively, over $4MM.
•	Pioneered a new tracking system for IT products and services that provided a sustainable trend analysis tool for pre & post project expenses.
•	Realized annual cost savings of 45% on capital and general expenditures through cost comparison and price negotiation. 
•	Initiated collaborative efforts with parent company, Sony Pictures Entertainment, to ensure entitlement and travel policies were consistent throughout the organization.

Directed and managed the activities of purchasing and travel personnel. Reviewed purchasing operations and practices to identify areas for continuous improvement. Audited purchase requisitions, purchase orders, invoices, American Express expense and general expense reports to meet organizational requirements and budgetary constraints. Managed MRO, computer hardware & software, travel and sales & marketing suppliers. Recorded all computer hardware and software purchases as required.  Administered and managed Corporate T&E and Corporate Purchasing Card programs. 

•Realized annual cost savings of 5-45% on capital and general expenditures through cost comparison and price negotiation. 
•Renegotiated Software License Agreements and pricing, achieving 10-35% cost savings per application. 
•Continuously met IT requirements through strategic planning and negotiation, decreasing lead times, pricing and delivery.
•Initiated collaborative efforts with parent company, Sony Pictures Entertainment, to ensure entitlement and travel policies were consistent throughout the organization.
•Generated and implemented novel purchasing procedures, improving the structure and efficiency of the work environment.
